753:t_039:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「This is bad! $$ジェニオン$$ can't hold out at this rate!」

753:t_039:5.en:
$$桂$$
「Even with all of us united, bringing every will gathering from across the universe into contact with the $$超特異点$$ exceeds our capacity!」

753:t_039:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Is this our limit, even with the power of $$真化融合$$?!」

753:t_039:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I told you it's impossible, you scum! How stupid can you be?!」

753:t_039:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It's over! For you... for the universe, for everything!!」

753:t_039:9.en:
$n
「Shut up, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! None of us has given up!」

753:t_039:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you've got time for your lousy heckling, lend us a hand!!」

753:t_039:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You must have touched the truth to become one of the $$御使い$$s too!」

753:t_039:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If you're going to save the universe, then save every life in it too!」

753:t_039:14.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're telling me to obey you...?!」

753:t_039:16.en:
$n
「Lend us your strength, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You're a life in this world too!」

753:t_039:17.en:
$n
「You feel joy, anger, sorrow and pleasure...! Now that you have them all, you can regain your human heart!」

753:t_039:18.en:
$n
「And now that you've lost eternity and felt the fear of death, you must have remembered what life means!!」

753:t_039:20.en:
$n
「Feel the life in this universe, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!!」

753:t_039:22.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...I admit defeat, $c... I could not become God, nor was I worthy of it...」

753:t_039:23.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And I would rather this heart of mine be filled with joy than sorrow, after all.」

753:t_039:25.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$n... I want to apologize to you... no, to every living being.」

753:t_039:26.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I too shall fulfill my true duty. To protect everything in this universe...」

753:t_039:28.en:
$$桂$$
「Let's do it! This time, we'll repair every world!!」

753:t_039:29.en:
$$桂$$
「No, that's wrong! We'll create every world anew!!」

753:t_039:30.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What awaits us beyond that is...」

753:t_039:31.en:
$n
「The wishes of each living person will decide that!」

753:t_039:33.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「These are... the people's wishes!」

753:t_039:35.en:
$$桂$$
「This will bring it all to an end...!」

753:t_040:0.en:
$$エスター$$
「We've taken care of the servants!」

753:t_040:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Is there any activity in $$エス・テラン$$?!」

753:t_040:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This battle won't end until we defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We're moving on to $$エス・テラン$$!」

753:t_041:0.en:
$$ネオ・マルダキエル$$
「I am the $$偽りの黒羊$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_042:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You tried hard, but your lies are nothing compared to $$アイム#pilot$$'s.」

753:t_043:0.en:
$$ネオ・アスモデル$$
「I am the $$欲深な金牛$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_044:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Desire isn't something someone else decides for you. It wells up from your own heart.」

753:t_044:1.en:
$$ランド$$
(Isn't that right, $$エルーナルーナ$$?)

753:t_045:0.en:
$$ネオ・アムブリエル$$
「I am the $$いがみ合う双子$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_046:0.en:
$n
「...Being the $$いがみ合う双子$$ Reactor isn't some special qualification...」

753:t_046:2.en:
$n
(That's exactly why the $$いがみ合う双子$$ forms the core of the twelve $$スフィア$$s...)

753:t_047:0.en:
$$ネオ・ムリエル$$
「I am the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_048:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Nothingness isn't the same as being empty. There's definitely a self within it.」

753:t_048:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「A puppet can't take $$尸空#pilot$$'s place.」

753:t_049:0.en:
$$ネオ・ウェルキエル$$
「I am the $$傷だらけの獅子$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_050:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「You don't have enough endurance to call yourself the $$傷だらけの獅子$$!」

753:t_051:0.en:
$$ネオ・ハマリエル$$
「I am the $$悲しみの乙女$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_052:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Sorrow was forced into you... That's the saddest thing of all...」

753:t_053:0.en:
$$ネオ・ズリエル$$
「I am the $$揺れる天秤$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_054:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If you can activate a $$スフィア$$ without getting buried in debt, maybe you were better suited to being a Reactor than me...」

753:t_055:0.en:
$$ネオ・バルビエル$$
「I am the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_056:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Meaningless hatred... It's such a hollow thing.」

753:t_056:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$バルビエル$$... I think the difference between my sorrow and your hatred must have been very small...)

753:t_057:0.en:
$$ネオ・アドナキエル$$
「I am the $$立ち上がる射手$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_058:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What could a puppet rebel against...?」

753:t_058:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, but $$ヴィルダーク$$ was ten times tougher than you.」

753:t_059:0.en:
$$ネオ・ハナエル$$
「I am the $$知りたがる山羊$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_060:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
(It's the $$スフィア$$ whose power $$アサキム$$ drew out...)

753:t_060:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Even if he was an image created by the system, $$アサキム$$ definitely lived...)

753:t_061:0.en:
$$ネオ・ガムビエル$$
「I am the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_062:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You can't save anything with love that's all talk.」

753:t_062:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
($$ユーサー・インサラウム$$... I'll never forget you or your love as long as I live...)

753:t_063:0.en:
$$ネオ・バキエル$$
「I am the $$夢見る双魚$$ Reactor... My existence is...」

753:t_064:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sleep tight, little puppet. Your dreams might be nightmares, though.」

753:t_065:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You reject my salvation...」

753:t_065:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Perhaps what you need is punishment, rather than salvation.」
